b: The next place we travelled to was Ninh Binh.. Apparently this is where they shot the King Kong film.. It looks like Ha Long Bay… But this is a village on land, surrounded by mountains…The roads inside haven't been developed much

The bus we came on stopped before the place we had to get off.. Only after we got off did we understand it wasn't our hotel… So then, walking with our bags and bundles, another hotel came along, and Sing Keeth started going in, saying this is the hotel.. It was 200 metres off the main road..Though the front of its name matched, the back didn't match the name we'd booked.. So Mithra said this isn't it, and Sing Keeth took us in saying don't I know, I booked it.. When we went and looked, it wasn't.. In her tiredness from walking 200 metres, Mithra didn't chase Sing Keeth and beat him.._

Somehow I walked ahead and found the hotel, and the hotel boy, seeing the state I'd arrived in, got his bike and brought everyone over.. As soon as we came they gave us juice and we perked up a bit. Since the boy was our age too, he chatted well.. Finally we decided to take bikes and look around the town..

That night we travelled half an hour and went to an Indian restaurant.. Everywhere we went, nature had scattered its beauty by the handful.On the way, by the roadside, they were selling a whole goat ( or deer..,I don't remember exactly) roasted..Looking at all this in wonder, we arrived at the restaurant..After many days, good food with masala and all.. That was the birthday dinner for both of us
Riding those rattletrap motorbikes on that road in the dark is very hard.. Somehow they skilfully brought us back and dropped us off

At night we sat and talked about where and how to go the next day, then slept and got up.. Breakfast was free… But that day my stomach was making a racket and I got scared.. Since the next day was a travel day, out of fear I only had yoghurt
When we'd finished eating and everything, we set off to see Mua Cave
